relation_to_idea.conceptual_difference: This work proposes LAMRF (logic-adaptive multi-source reasoning fusion) for multi-hop KGQA. Our idea enriches training triples with local context subgraphs from the same passage and adds an adaptive repair loop for one-hop failures, focusing on training data enrichment and iterative correction rather than a specific reasoning fusion mechanism.
